newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Deroma to make Milan bourse debut in March.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Deroma to make Milan bourse debut in March.

text.p: Italian terracotta pot-maker Deroma Holding will make its Milan bourse debut in the first week of March after a 5.6 million public share offering this month.
Global coordinator Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and joint lead manager Credito Italiano made the announcement at the start of a roadshow which will take in Franfurt, London and New York.
The share price for the offering by the world leader in terracotta pots and vases, to be open on February 17 and 18, will be in a 9,000-11,000 lire range to be set on February 15.
The operation will raise a net 46.4 to 57.6 billion lire.
The company, established in 1955, has six manufacturing centres, including ones in Denmark and in China.
Deroma had estimated 1996 turnover of 114 billion lire against 107 billion in 1995, about 80 percent of turnover coming from outside Italy.
